ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Touch Padel uses the camera only when you take a profile photo or a work photo, or scan the desk QR code to start or finish work.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Touch Padel uses your photos only when you choose a profile photo or attach a work photo.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Touch Padel uses your phone's motion only to move your points card as you tilt the phone. It never counts steps or tracks activity.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Touch Padel uses your location only when a staff member starts or finishes work, to check they are at the club. It is read at that moment only, never in the background.
